[p1]
DATA SHEET
uES4F
Industrial 4 Port Unmanaged Ethernet Switch
IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 Compliant
Product Overview
The uES4F is an unmanaged industrial grade cost-effective 4 ports Ethernet switch which is IEC
61850-3 and IEEE 1613 Compliant. The uES4F also supports MDI/MDIX auto detection, so no
crossover wires are needed. The switch is made of IP-40 galvanized steel, accepts a wide voltage
range of 9-36VDC, 36-75VDC, to high voltage of input 110-370VDC or 90-264VAC.
These features combined with a wide operating temperature of -40°C to 85°C help protect
mission-critical applications from network interruptions or temporary malfunctions and make
it suitable for the harshest of environments without the use of fans.

[p2]
Features and Benefits
Table 1. Features
FEATURE
•2 x 10/100Base-T(X) auto-negotiation and auto-MDI/MDI-X portsand
•2 X 100Base-X SFP ports
SUPPORTS •Auto-Negotiation function for 100Base-TX interface
•Full/half duplex operation
•Store and Forward transmission
IP-40 GALVANIZED STEEL HOUSING
OPERATING TEMPERATURE ‐40°C TO +85°C
